text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp has come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However… Yamanin Zephyr is nowhere to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's almost time for the bus to depart… but I think I might know where she is…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Playing on the white-capped waves, sweeping briskly across the water's surface… Hehe, the ocean breeze is as carefree as ever today.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I was just saying farewell… to the ocean, and to the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: All the things this place has given me… I'm going to take them home and cherish them.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And that includes the memories brought by the sudden gusts… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Partings are sad, but that sadness is fleeting as well. I believe the wind's blessings are safe with me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Regarding my upcoming race—I have every intention of running like the rushing wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'll stir up a wind that travels far and wide, all the way back here to the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch as Yamanin Zephyr walks away with the lightness of the wind.
